home.summary: Islamic learning, congregational prayer and daily service at Jama Masjid Al-Azeem.

about.label: About the Markaz
about.heading: A place to learn, pray and serve
about.body: Founded in 2019, Markaz Al Azeem is a madrasa at Jama Masjid Al-Azeem. Alongside the madrasa’s teaching, the Markaz runs a daily community lunch and a local clinic.

education.title: Islamic education
education.body: Students learn at the madrasa, with residential facilities for those who live on site.

meals.title: Community kitchen
meals.body: The kitchen prepares and serves a free lunch every day.

clinic.title: Local clinic
clinic.body: The clinic sees patients from the surrounding community.

campus.label: Campus
campus.heading: Inside Markaz Al Azeem
campus.previewNote: The preview shows Wazir Khan Mosque in Lahore. Markaz Al Azeem’s own campus media will appear here.
